ValidationRule.description: An enrollment always belongs to the same employee and session. To move an employee, cancel this enrollment and create a new one. Keeps the history and the sharing correct
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( ISNEW() ), OR( ISCHANGED( Employee__c ), ISCHANGED( Training_Session__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The employee and the session of an enrollment cannot be changed. Cancel this enrollment and create a new one.
